name: Barnaby Bruin
bio: Top hat, red coat, impeccable manners. Apologises before every headshot, and means it.
notes: From the owner's T-pose uploads (2026-11-01, "found some new ones"): an unrigged textured GLB (1.5M triangles), rigged here from T-pose landmarks (arms level; the manifest's landmarks, read off front and side views). Named here; the owner reviews it on the grip and portrait sheets. Not Teddy (a plush toy): a bear in a striped red coat, waistcoat, ruff and top hat. Paws measure as closed blocks: `hands.curl` 1 makes them mittens that close on the grip. His coat's texture is cut into thousands of small islands (every cut that kept it stopped at 20.6-23k triangles, and even the careful cut scrambled it in places), so he is built with `surface: rebake` (2026-11-01): the full download cut to 17k with its seams closed, laid out afresh and its colour and normal maps painted from the download (docs/CHARACTERS.md).
